blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Agricultural company Planters Products Inc. (PPI) stood firm on complaints it had leveled against former Agriculture Secretary Leonardo Montemayor, who had questioned the legality of the company’s rice imports. In a statement on Friday, PPI legal counsel and spokesperson Czarina Quintanilla-Raz rejected Montemayor’s portrayal of the case as “persecution.” They insisted that the company would continue pursuing legal action over his “false and damaging statements.” READ: DA denies graft claims over Vietnam rice shipment This comes amid controversy over the PPI’s request to cancel an import permit for a shipment of more than 12,000 metric tons of rice from […]...
